RAGHAVA G. N

RAGHAVA G. N

Senior Leadership Profile

Program Manager | Director – Technology & Service Delivery | Banking & Capital Markets

raghava_usa@yahoo.co.in   | +91 9972503557 | https://www.linkedin.com/in/raghavagn

Catalyst for: Enterprise Transformation & High-Performance Delivery ▪ Scaling Banking Platforms through Cloud Modernization, Governance & Global Leadership ▪ Enabling Sustainable Business Growth

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

PMP and ITIL certified transformation leader with 24+ years of experience in Banking, Capital Markets, Digital Transformation, Program Management, Change Management, Cloud Modernization and Operational Excellence. Led large-scale transformation programs across Canada, Singapore and India for global banking clients. Experienced in digital product delivery, process automation, front-office effectiveness improvement, stakeholder management, agile delivery, analytics-driven decision making, cloud migration, AI adoption and enterprise-wide change initiatives.

Proven expertise in program and portfolio management, service delivery governance, cloud modernization, and application lifecycle management;  managing front-office and back-office platforms through global offshore–onsite delivery models.

Recognized for building and leading large, multi-geography teams (190+ associates), aligning technology initiatives with business objectives, and consistently delivering on-time, on-budget outcomes with quantifiable cost/risk reduction, and operational excellence.

Strong track record in embedding continuous service improvement (CSI), ensuring service stability, driving revenue growth, business development, while enhancing system reliability, customer experience, and business throughput across Capital Markets, OTC Derivatives, Collateral, Client Valuations, and Risk & Analytics domains.

Key Skills:

Digital Transformation | Change Management | Program & Portfolio Management | Agile Delivery | PMP | Front Office Transformation | Process Automation | Operational Excellence | Stakeholder Management | Cloud Migration | AI & GenAI Adoption | Analytics & Data Driven Decision Making | Banking & Capital Markets | Business Process Reengineering | Governance & Risk Management | Training & User Adoption | Executive Communication

Key Career Milestones:

Led enterprise digital transformation and cloud modernization programs for global banking organizations.

Delivered cloud migration of 200+ integrations and 150+ APIs resulting in approximately $5M annual cost savings.

Improved operational efficiency through automation and continuous service improvement initiatives reducing manual effort by 30–50%.

Managed and coached global teams of 190+ associates across multiple geographies.

Drove stakeholder engagement, governance forums, workshops, training and change adoption programs.

Improved business throughput, customer satisfaction and service stability across front-office and risk platforms.

Applied AI, automation and modern technology solutions to improve service delivery and operational performance.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Program & Portfolio Leadership | ITIL-Led Service Delivery | Enterprise Digital Transformation | Global Delivery Models | Executive Stakeholder Management | Capital Markets & Investment Banking | OTC Derivatives & Collateral | Client Valuations & Risk Platforms | SLA / KPI Governance | Continuous Service Improvement (CSI) | Cost Optimization | Risk & Issue Management | RFP & Contract Governance | Vendor & Partner Management | Talent Leadership & Coaching | Agile & Waterfall Delivery

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE & ACCOMPLISHMENTS

Program Manager – NMIC (National Mortgage Insurance Corporation)

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) | Bangalore, India, Aug 2024 – Sep 2025 

Led B2B digital transformation initiatives and modernization of legacy integrations using MuleSoft.

Managed transformation roadmap, stakeholder communication and delivery governance.

Presented Improved operational effectiveness through process optimization and service improvement initiatives.

Managed program planning, governance, stakeholder communication, delivery execution, risk management, and transformation roadmaps.

Collaborated with business and technology stakeholders to identify AI-driven opportunities for process optimization and operational efficiency.

Established executive governance frameworks, program dashboards, delivery reporting, and resource management processes.

Enabled cross-functional collaboration across product, engineering, business, and data teams to drive transformation outcomes.

Improved delivery efficiency by over 20% through governance optimization, Agile delivery models, and performance management frameworks.

Program Manager – PayPal

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) | Canada, Jan 2024 – Aug 2024

Managed global transformation and transition programs across multiple platforms.

Established delivery governance, stakeholder alignment and operational excellence frameworks.

Led cross-functional teams supporting digital platform modernization.

Supported AI adoption initiatives leveraging Predictive Analytics, Gen-AI, Intelligent Automation, Data Analytics, and Process Transformation.

Collaborated with business and technology stakeholders to identify AI-driven opportunities for process optimization and operational efficiency.

Established executive dashboards using Power BI providing visibility into delivery performance, operational KPIs, portfolio health, and business outcomes.

Program Manager – Bank of Montreal (BMO)

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) | Canada & India, Jul 2018 – Jan 2024

Led large-scale banking transformation programs across Capital Markets, Enterprise Risk and Digital Core portfolios

Led 190+ associates across multiple geographies, ensuring on-time delivery across Capital Markets, Enterprise Risk, and Digital Core portfolios.

Oversaw cloud migration programs, achieving ~$5M annual savings by eliminating Tibco licensing costs.

Managed $15M+ annual contract revenue, maintaining profitability through cost control and revenue forecasting.

Managed cloud migration, automation and modernization initiatives delivering significant cost savings.

Led multiple AI/ML and Digital Transformation programs across Banking, Financial Services and Enterprise domains.

Conducted executive governance reviews, workshops and stakeholder engagement sessions.

Defined KPIs, metrics, and performance metrics and transformation roadmaps to improve business outcomes.

Coached delivery teams on agile methodologies, program governance and continuous improvement.

Built high-performing cross-functional teams across Engineering, QA, Data, Operations, and Shared Services.

Accelerated transformation initiatives through AI-enabled governance and data-driven decision-making.

Improved delivery predictability and executive visibility across strategic programs.

Program Manager – Barclays

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) | Bangalore, India, Jul 2016 – Jun 2018

Led front-office transformation and risk platform initiatives.

Improved operational efficiency through process redesign and service transformation

Improved delivery efficiency by over 20% through governance optimization, Agile delivery models, and performance management frameworks.

Built high-performing cross-functional teams across Engineering, QA, Data, Operations, and Shared Services.

Assistant Vice President – Front Office Applications

Credit Suisse | Bangalore, India, Dec 2013 – Mar 2016

Partnered with business, compliance, and IT leadership to assess regulatory reporting impacts of business initiatives.

Delivered cost optimization and operational improvements while maintaining service stability.

Owned portfolio governance including budgeting, roadmap planning, dependency management, resource forecasting, executive reporting, and risk mitigation.

Managed workforce planning, talent development, vendor management, organizational growth, and business alignment initiatives.

Built and scaled delivery organizations from 30 to 60+ FTEs, ultimately managing a global organization of 80+ professionals.

Led L2/L3 front-office application support for mission-critical trading systems

Senior Technical Consultant – Credit Suisse

Optimum Solutions | Singapore, Apr 2008 – Dec 2013

Delivered end-to-end project management for SNP initiatives across front and back-office collateral and valuation systems.

Acted as business–technology liaison, producing BRDs, performing gap analysis, and aligning solutions with industry standards.

Automated manual processes and optimized batch processing, improving system reliability.

Provided L2/L3 production support, DR readiness, and developer training on functional concepts.

EARLY CAREER

TECHNICAL LEAD (INDIA) | Wipro Technologies                                                       	         Dec 2007 – Apr 2008

TEAM LEAD (INDIA) | Indecomm Global Services                                                                 Feb 2005 – Nov 2007

SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER (INDIA) | ANZ IT                                                                    Mar 2004 – Feb 2005

DEVELOPER (INDIA) | Systematic Solutions                                                                         Nov 2001 – Mar 2004

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

Master of Computer Application, VTU, India, 2001

Bachelor of Computer Science, Mysore University, India, 1998

Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) 2012, Singapore |Six Sigma Green Belt, 2012, Singapore Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) 2012, Singapore	

Technical Exposure

AWS | MuleSoft | Informatica | BizTalk | Jenkins | Git | Jira | SonarQube | GenAI | ServiceNow AI | .NET Technologies | SQL Server | Oracle | Linux/Unix
